meta.label: swarm-idle
meta.script: idle 40 s → thrust/yaw probes → kiting fighter: aim+fire at nearest hostile, hold 230–400 u range, burn away from packs of 3+ inside 450 u, strafe, break off under fire, latch every 7th beat; probes + shots at every round start · gate idle pass · no invulnerability (the only toggle is the physics-lab practice rack, not offered in Swarm/Gauntlet)

items.name: Ordnance top-up
items.desc: Impulse charges racked to full for the charge-rack builds.

items.name: Autocannon S
items.desc: Armor-biting slugs kick light hulls sideways. Aim off-center to spoil their firing line.

items.name: Cargo Scanner S
items.desc: Reads what another hull is carrying.

items.name: Concussion Cannon S
items.desc: Punch light hulls into rocks. Direct damage is low; the collision is the payoff.

items.name: Heavy-Duty Winch
items.desc: The line hauls them to you. You are the winch, not the bait.

items.name: Impulse Charge Rack
items.desc: Impulse charges on the rack — a shove for whatever is on top of you.

items.name: Ion Thruster M
items.desc: The yard drive. Push and the run stay where this hull was rated.

items.name: Loot Magnet Ring S
items.desc: Debris and pods drift into the hull as you fly past.

items.name: Market Data Uplink S
items.desc: Streams live exchange quotes from every station in this sector while you fly it.

items.name: Pulse Laser S
items.desc: Quick, precise bolts that nudge light hulls. Keep the nose on target and leave room to cool.

items.name: Ram Plate
items.desc: A ram plate. Flying through something stops being your problem.

items.name: Sensor Scrambler S
items.desc: You read quieter on a scan than the hull you are.

items.name: Shield Booster S
items.desc: A heavier screen between the swarm and your hull.

items.name: Stripped RCS S
items.desc: You give up turn, slide and brake. The hull commits, and it answers late.

items.name: Swing Drive S
items.desc: The same swing-around dash, in the small bay a starter hull can fit.

items.name: Thermal Sink S
items.desc: Heat leaves the guns so you can hold the trigger.

items.name: Veil Step
items.desc: Hold Shift and a shadow of the ship sits ahead. Release, and you are there. The thruster boost is gone while this is fitted.

items.name: Bank Stream M
items.desc: A fast stream that ricochets off stone. Use the wall to reach around a firing line.

items.name: Bio-Spectral Pass Head
items.desc: Biological contacts resolve one classification rung earlier.

items.name: Biofilm Filter Stack
items.desc: Contaminated space fouls the hull more slowly.

items.name: Cryo Payload
items.desc: Hits freeze a hull stiff so the next blow lands on something that cannot yield.

items.name: Drill Amp
items.desc: The rich-core window on a rock stays open a little longer.

items.name: Echo Recorder
items.desc: Relay pulses that stay in phase leave a note in the flight log.

items.name: Endurance Drive M
items.desc: Faster long straights than Fusion, with less power draw. Slower to get moving; plan the burn before the corner opens.

items.name: Field Coherence Meter
items.desc: Inside a colonized field, the flight log notes whether that ecology is still coherent.

items.name: Filament Contrast Filter
items.desc: Phantom contacts in a colonized field are marked with a question mark.

items.name: Flak/PD Turret S
items.desc: A tracking flak turret that also intercepts incoming missiles. Its firing arc leaves your rear exposed.

items.name: Forked Core
items.desc: Every shot splits. One trigger pull, two things to hit.

items.name: Fusion Drive M
items.desc: More thrust under you. The whole fight gets faster.

items.name: Grav Anchor
items.desc: Shoot two different bodies to spring-link them. The line contracts and turns their mass into a collision.

items.name: Gravity Bumper S
items.desc: Boost into a body to throw it from the nose. More closing speed means a harder shove.

items.name: Gravity Marker S
items.desc: Tag a body so wells and sinks grip it harder. The mark prepares your next move; it is not a killing shot.

items.name: Gravity Tag
items.desc: Hits mark a hull so the well takes that one.

items.name: Grip Bumper S
items.desc: Boost to catch a light hostile on the nose. Carry it into the pile, then release boost to let it go.

items.name: Hardlight Prism
items.desc: Place an angled reflector ahead of you. Bank a cutting beam through it or make a nearby surface reflective.

items.name: Heat Lure Beacon
items.desc: Throw a charge that burns hotter than you, and heat-hunters chase it.

items.name: Herald Fan
items.desc: Shots spread as they travel — worse on one, better on eight.

items.name: Incendiary Payload
items.desc: Hits keep burning after the shot has gone.

items.name: Inertial Shunt S
items.desc: A fitted ram plate transfers your closing speed into the other hull. The collision does the work.

items.name: Ion Payload
items.desc: Hits bleed into systems, not just plating.

items.name: Missile Rack M
items.desc: Guided missiles chase a locked target and explode on contact. Give the lock time to settle.

items.name: Momentum Sink S
items.desc: Latch a ship to your motion, or tag a rock and burn away. Trigger again to release the stored slingshot.

items.name: Piercing Core
items.desc: Shots carry through the first hull into whatever is behind it.

items.name: Polarity Inverter
items.desc: Shots alternate positive and negative charge. Opposites pull together; matching poles push apart.

items.name: Pulse Laser M
items.desc: Heavier pulse bolts with a stronger shove. A steady aim beats spraying the room.

items.name: Quantum Sympathy
items.desc: Shoot two different bodies to link their impulses. Hit one and the other shares the kick.

items.name: Quarantine Locker
items.desc: Biohazard cargo in the hold does not foul the hull.

items.name: Railgun M
items.desc: A fast armor-piercing spear with a solid kick. Lead the target; a missed shot has a long pause.

items.name: Relay Arc
items.desc: A hit jumps to the next hull in reach. Tight packs kill themselves.

items.name: Relay Needle
items.desc: A relay organism reports whether its broadcast is still coherent.

items.name: Seismic Gong
items.desc: Turn a struck body into a pulsing shock source. A heavy host makes the surrounding pile jump.

items.name: Shield Capacitor M
items.desc: A much thicker shield, and it comes back faster.

items.name: Signal Decoy Buoy S
items.desc: Puts a false contact in the water and missiles go for it.

items.name: Sprint Drive M
items.desc: Leaves a corner harder than Fusion, but runs slower on long straights and draws more power. Your RCS still owns the turn and stop.

items.name: Tether Capacitor
items.desc: Shots into the hull on your line hit harder, up to a cap.

items.name: Thruster Hijacker
items.desc: Attach a rogue thruster that spins and drives its host. Let the room finish what the dart starts.

items.name: Triangulation Suite S
items.desc: Closes an anomaly fix in two scans instead of three.

items.name: Twin Mount
items.desc: Every gun grows a second barrel.

items.name: Vector Mine M
items.desc: Drop a scatter charge that throws nearby bodies apart. It deals no direct damage; hard landings still hurt.

items.name: Vernier Cluster M
items.desc: The nose comes around harder, and you slide and stop with more authority.

items.name: Viscosity Field
items.desc: Lay a short-lived gel field ahead of the nose. Crossing bodies lose motion; heat can ignite the trap.

items.name: Hull weld
items.desc: Plate, weld and rinse the scars. Back to full before the next pack.

items.name: Beam Laser M
items.desc: Hold a continuous cutting beam on the target. Break contact to let the gun cool.

items.name: Containment Seal Kit
items.desc: A station that would refuse a biological lot will take it.

items.name: EMP Disruptor M
items.desc: Bypasses shields to disable ship systems. Use the opening to ram, capture or switch to a hull-damaging weapon.

items.name: Fire Lance S
items.desc: Boost to light a narrow burning lance on the nose. Drive it through a target while the boost lasts.

items.name: Gravity Bumper S Mk2
items.desc: Boost with a wider, stronger gravity bumper. The upgrade stays active while your boost is burning.

items.name: Gravity Wellhead M
items.desc: Draw a fight into a sustained gravity well. Follow the clump with a blast or a heavy body.

items.name: Grip Bumper S Mk2
items.desc: Boost with a wider grip to catch and carry a hostile hull. Release boost to release the catch.

items.name: Host-Memory Cartography
items.desc: Crossing into a colonized field names the hull under the growth.

items.name: Plasma Cannon M
items.desc: Luminous slugs burst into a hot splash. Clustered targets pay for each other.

items.name: Point-Defense Servo S
items.desc: Knocks down a shot or a missile that gets in close.

items.name: Quiet Mask
items.desc: Animals that hunt by heat notice this hull later.

items.name: RCS Disruptor M
items.desc: Interrupt steering and leave the target drifting. Strike before its helm recovers.

items.name: Snarl Webcaster
items.desc: Pin two bodies with a web and let their struggle pull the fight apart.

items.name: Vector Charge Rack
items.desc: Carries the same charges, and you can kick one out behind you.

items.name: Warp Coil L
items.desc: The long run. You still fight at the same cap, and you travel much faster.

items.name: Fire Lance S Mk2
items.desc: Boost with a longer, hotter nose lance. Keep contact while the boost meter is paying for it.

items.name: Storm Carom
items.desc: A bounced hit storms through ionized targets. A direct hit cannot jump.
